q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of tile adhesive per kg?
title: Tile adhesive carbon footprint per kg
short: Cement usually drives most of the footprint: multiply the cement per kg of adhesive by its supplier figure. Add sand, polymers and bags, then drying, blending and packing energy divided by kg packed.

p: Report per kg by class. Sand drying with a burner adds fuel that bought dry sand does not.

example.title: Worked example: tile adhesive unit per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 18,690 / 3,000,000 = 0.00623 kg CO2 per kg
Add cement, sand and polymer for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
